responsibility: Auto-generated documentation-link companion for gcc/config/arc/arc-tables.opt. In GCC’s option-description subsystem, .opt.urls files attach manual URL suffix metadata to option records so diagnostics, help, or generated option documentation can point back to the relevant manual anchors; for this ARC fragment it serves the generated -mcpu enum table and is regenerated from the corresponding .opt input plus built HTML documentation. Since the underlying table only enumerates valid CPU names, this file typically contains little or no per-entry content beyond the generated header.
